trigger: EXPLORATORY power check on the 20 spent non-calibration runs (scripts/robotarium/power_study_b.py, docs/research/vision_caution_study_b_power_v1.json and _v2.json): the registered G1 passes in 1-4% of resampled sealed sets at every size from 4 to 16 usable runs. The composite sim head ranks hazards well (pooled AUC-PR 0.431 vs action-only 0.226) but at the half-budget threshold catches 9.1% of hazards vs 7.3%, so the recall-difference CI almost never clears zero. More sealed seeds do not fix this.
G1_amended: on sealed decisions, the episode-cluster bootstrap (10000 replicates, seed 0; replicates without both classes skipped and counted) CI95 lower bound of AUC-PR(vision_sim_arena) - AUC-PR(action_only) is > 0
G2: unchanged: vision_sim_arena realized false-alarm rate on sealed hazard-free decisions <= 0.10 at its registered threshold
S1_amended: AUC-PR-difference CI95 lower bound > 0 for vision_sim_finetune vs action_only, and vision_sim_finetune's realized false-alarm rate <= 0.10
S2_amended: AUC-PR-difference CI95 lower bound > 0 for vision_sim_finetune vs vision_sim_arena
registered_v3_criteria: still computed and reported unchanged as G1_recall_registered_v3, S1_recall_registered_v3, S2_recall_registered_v3 (higher AUC-PR, higher recall, recall-difference CI95 lower bound > 0); they no longer decide success
what_the_amended_gate_claims: the camera head ranks real hazards above benign decisions better than the action-only control (threshold-free). It does not claim that alarms at the registered threshold catch many hazards; recall at the threshold, the realized false-alarm rate and recall by hazard type stay reported.
